title: Rust: qualified beacon and timer-owner integration
description:
Connect rust/lichen-core/src/desync.rs, rust/lichen-rpl/src/multi_instance.rs, rust/lichen-link/src/epoch_floor.rs and the beacon/timer owner in rust/lichen-node/src/runtime.rs. Only authenticated synchronization objects with authorized time provenance, valid floor/freshness and current root/generation may maintain or recover CCP2. Consume hold-off completion and SFN reset in real runtime state rather than leave them as helper return values.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Reuse b7z9.25's closed arithmetic/FSM/vector helpers and pxxl's missed-beacon row. Those closures do not establish production event wiring. b7z9.28 is only a reference for already accepted signer-retirement/invalidation interfaces, not a legacy prerequisite or authorization to rewrite attestations. Follow canonical time-quality ordering and preserve identity, baseline SCHC/security, custody and deferred key portability; no OSCORE/EDHOC edits.
acceptance_criteria: Consume vectors.05 through the production beacon and timer paths. Test ordinary signed data, malformed/bad-signature/retired-signer beacons, stale generation, invalid time, exactly three missed beacons, interrupted and three-valid-beacon recovery, wrap and root/generation changes. Assert actual schedule suppression and clock/state reset, not only flags. Extend core desync, rust/lichen-rpl/tests/ccp16_desync_vectors.rs and node runtime tests; run feature-qualified tests, no_std checks where supported, fmt and clippy.
